history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration optimize the occupational safety and health incident collection, analysis, response and reporting procedures within the Secretariat.
history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. The optimized and enhanced end-user interface, including online training for the existing occupational safety and health incident reporting system was successfully rolled out. The online training for the incident reporting system has been made available to all United Nations Secretariat personnel wherever dedicated occupational safety and health personnel exist. The Administration kindly requests the Board to close this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given the supporting documents have been provided that the online training for OSH – IRS has been made available to all United Nations Secretariat personnel wherever dedicated OSH personnel, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
